description: Stage-3 pass 5 (F16, a campaign failure: fuzz-tool-call seed 11): a bracketless Mistral v3 list whose first object fails at its name (`oops`, at 32) ends at the bracket closing that object, and the second object, a call body cut inside a key (`{"name": "read_file", "argu`), follows after only a separator.
